message.content:
The vertical rectangular illustration shows a magazine cover with various text elements and a central figure. At the top, the large white word "TEMPO" is printed, with the number "55" above its right side. Below it, smaller letters read "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU".

The central figure is a man in a black suit, white shirt, and black shoes, seen from behind and side. He is walking towards a dark, open doorway. His right arm is slightly extended, and his head is turned to his left. To the right, another hand in a black suit sleeve grips a circular metallic door handle on a thick, dark gray door. This door has a small, square, mesh-covered window.

The background features a brown wall with rows of small, dark, circular spots, resembling a storage locker or vault. Large white text in the bottom right corner reads "AMBYAR BANK SENTRAL", followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with "Perry Warjiyo tiba-tiba mundur...". The bottom left contains a barcode and a QR code, while the bottom center lists dates, price, and other publication details. Other headlines at the top include "Prabowo Makin Tak Populer" and "Bahan Bakar Kebakaran Hutan".
